subject: Board packet prep: ARR reconciliation & pipeline cleanroom requests
messages:
From: Mina Haddad <mina_haddad@redwood.com>
To: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Cc: Board Secretariat <board@board.redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 30 Jul 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Board packet prep: ARR reconciliation & pipeline cleanroom requests

Team — attaching the first pass at the Q3 board metrics workbook (sheet: ARR + bookings). We need a quick-clean sweep of the commit definitions and stage hygiene before we lock numbers Friday COB. High level asks: 

1) Sales owners: verify every $50k+ commit in the tracker (sheet: commits) has a documented close reason and customer signature link. If it’s in negotiation > terms, mark as "At-Risk" with a short note.
2) Ops/Finance: reconcile billed bookings vs recognized ARR delta for three accounts flagged in red (Bluecrest trial conversion; ACME P1; and Meridian strategic). Provide journal entries or timing notes if recognition will be deferred.
3) Leadership: confirm any manual adjustments you expect to ask us to include in the board deck narrative (e.g., one-time credits, partner rebates).

I've also added a cleanroom tracker (commit_sweep_tracker.csv) with rows for owner, amount, SFDC opp link, commit reason, and supporting doc link. Please update by EOD Thursday (2026-07-30) so finance can run the adjusted ARR reconciliation Friday morning.

Attachments: 2026_Q3_board_metrics_draft.xlsx (workbook), commit_sweep_tracker.csv (editable)

Thanks — Mina
Mina Haddad
Head of Finance Operations
Redwood Inference

From: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>
To: Mina Haddad <mina_haddad@redwood.com>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 30 Jul 2026 11:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Board packet prep: ARR reconciliation & pipeline cleanroom requests

Thanks, Mina — I went through the >$50k rows and left comments in the tracker. Quick notes:
- Bluecrest (Opp #R-445): oral commitment received; awaiting DocuSign. Marked as "Pending signature" and left the expected sign date 8/4.
- ACME P1: this one is complicated; customer requires a 60-day trial before recognizing ARR. Marked "At-Risk" and added negotiation note.
- Meridian: moved to "Commit" per CS confirmation, added the contract reference (Drive link).

I can't reconcile recognition timing (finance ask) — please advise if we should treat Bluecrest as Q3 booking or Q4 recognized ARR for the board.

Laura
VP Sales Ops

From: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.com>
To: Mina Haddad <mina_haddad@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 30 Jul 2026 12:20:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Board packet prep: ARR reconciliation & pipeline cleanroom requests

Mina/Laura — quick governance ask: for the board packet I prefer ARR to reflect conservative recognition (i.e., only fully-signed, deployable deals). Bluecrest should show as "Booked (pending signature)" in bookings table but excluded from ARR until the DocuSign clears. We'll call it out in the narrative with the expected impact if it converts in Aug.

I'll review the narrative language later today — please flag any other one-offs.

-Vivek
Chief Revenue Officer

From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
To: Mina Haddad <mina_haddad@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 31 Jul 2026 09:06:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Board packet prep: ARR reconciliation & pipeline cleanroom requests

Looping in a quick CS confirmation: I spoke with the Meridian AM — deployment is scheduled and MOUs signed. I've uploaded the signed MOU to the Drive link in the tracker. I've also added the renewal wording for ACME that will prevent early recognition until the trial completes.

Marissa
Director, Customer Success

Cc: Kevin Hart <kevin.hart@acme-analytics.com>, Erin Matthews <erin@bluecrestcap.com>
Date: Fri, 31 Jul 2026 15:45:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Board packet prep: ARR reconciliation & pipeline cleanroom requests

Thanks for the quick updates. Finance will treat booked vs recognized as Vivek suggested (conservative recognition). Operational asks: 

- Laura: mark Bluecrest as booking but exclude from ARR; add DocuSign link in the tracker so we can flip it if it arrives before packet lock.
- Marissa: copy of Meridian MOU received — thanks. We'll include a line in the narrative about timing and expected contribution to ARR in Q4.
- Kevin (cc'd): FYI on the ACME trial wording. We may need a short memo from legal confirming deferred revenue treatment — can you help expedite?

Action: everyone, please confirm your tracker rows are complete and upload any supporting docs by EOD Thursday 8/6 (board packet lock is 8/7 10:00 PDT). Finance will run final reconciliation 8/7 morning and circulate the final numbers and narrative.

Attachments: commit_sweep_tracker.csv

Mina
